reason: The README describes a skill that guides AI coding agents to make minimal, scoped changes in existing projects while avoiding unrelated refactoring and protecting shared foundation code.

summaries.zh: 为AI编程代理提供保守代码修改指导，帮助其在现有项目中进行最小范围的必要变更并减少无关重构。
summaries.en: Guides AI coding agents to make minimal, scoped changes in existing projects while avoiding unrelated refactoring.

capabilities: provides guidance for AI coding agents
guides minimal, scoped edits to existing project code and resources
encourages preserving architecture and avoiding unrelated refactoring
prompts agents to seek approval before editing shared foundation code
guides use of dynamic color resources for supported dark-mode projects
